exposure: Women in need of labor induction
Women with symptoms of active labor
Emergency cesarean section (ECS) indication (fetal distress, obstructed labor, or combined)
outcome: Association between fetal biometry and ECS
Predictive accuracy of ultrasound and Bishop score for ECS
cohort: Women who presented with symptoms of active labor or women in need of labor induction
finding: The study found that routine ultrasound assessment at labor admission, in addition to Bishop score assessment, did not significantly improve the prediction of emergency cesarean section.
mod_finding: Ultrasound assessment of fetal biometry at admission did not significantly improve the prediction of emergency cesarean section.
